process: A painter is laying green and blue watercolor washes onto taped paper with a brush.

stages.state: green strip beside pale blue wash
stages.prompt: A close-up of a hand holding a fine dark paintbrush over a sheet of watercolor paper taped to brown cardboard. The paper shows a pale blue wash on the right and a green strip beside a faint orange-brown edge, with the left part still blank. A watercolor palette with blue, yellow and red pans and a crumpled tissue sit blurred on the table behind.

A close-up of a hand holding a fine dark paintbrush over a sheet of watercolor paper taped to brown cardboard. The brush has laid a wider band of green wash that is spreading leftward across the blank paper, and the pale blue area on the right is slightly deeper. A watercolor palette with blue, yellow and red pans and a crumpled tissue sit blurred on the table behind.

stages.state: green covers most of left paper
stages.prompt: A close-up of a hand holding a fine dark paintbrush over a sheet of watercolor paper taped to brown cardboard. The green wash now covers most of the left third of the paper, reaching close to the taped top edge, and the blue area on the right is noticeably deeper. The brush sits at the leading edge of the wet green. A watercolor palette with blue, yellow and red pans sits blurred on the table behind.
